trivial.description: Cheapest/fastest model. Typos, lint fixes, single-file mechanical changes. pi has no permission modes: tools run without prompting unless an installed extension asks for approval.

easy.description: Small, well-specified bugfixes or features. pi has no permission modes: tools run without prompting unless an installed extension asks for approval.

standard.description: Default tier for most issue work. pi has no permission modes: tools run without prompting unless an installed extension asks for approval.

hard.description: Tricky refactors, ambiguous specs, anything touching shared/critical code. pi has no permission modes: tools run without prompting unless an installed extension asks for approval.

extreme.description: Hardest problems, strongest available model. pi has no permission modes: tools run without prompting unless an installed extension asks for approval. For a second harness's judgment, override with e.g. --agent claude --model fable or --agent codex — verify their exact model ids yourself, this repo doesn't validate them.
